source: BSE (MktCapFull / LTP) vs Munshot (Market Cap / Current Price), adjudicated against NSE pre-open where it covers the company
note: Share counts, not market caps: each side's count is derived inside its own source so no price difference leaks in. An exact rational ratio means a corporate action is involved but does NOT say which side missed it — only a third source can, and NSE pre-open covers 261 symbols. Anything not resolved by a third source is quarantined.

findings.name: IndiaMART InterMESH Ltd
